# Common Cells vendoring note

`cf_math_pkg.sv`, `lzc.sv`, and `rr_arb_tree.sv` are the only common-cells
modules required by FPnew.  They come from `pulp-platform/common_cells` v1.21.0,
commit `6aeee85d0a34fedc06c14f04fd6363c9f7b4eeea`, under the included license.

Upstream: https://github.com/pulp-platform/common_cells
